trap.label: into
trap.wrong: She made a translation of the play to English.
trap.right: She made a translation of the play into English.
trap.why: Em português “traduzir para o inglês” usa para; o aluno copia to. Em inglês, translate into a language.

mcq.q: Pick the noun for a changed script:

fix.wrong: The direction is good, however the pacing drags.
fix.right: The direction is good; however, the pacing drags.

fix.wrong: The play translated to Portuguese was staged.
fix.right: The play translated into Portuguese was staged.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com translated into: “She translated the play to English.”
rewrite.answer: She translated the play into English.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com ensemble: “The cast works well together.”
Reescreva no passado: “The revival opens in June.”
